title: Clock simulation states
statement: For a state set $S$, introduce a state type with four forms: a decrement state carrying a body state and a flag phase; a body state carrying a body state; a finish state carrying an optional body state; and a timeout state carrying an optional body state. The flag phase is either the forward run phase, a rewind phase carrying a Boolean flag, or a done phase carrying a Boolean flag.
